✨ Stunning gastronomic oasis in the heart of Hanoi: a professional audit of Puro House for 5 stars! ✨
Aug 2026 • Family
After visiting the famous, incredibly Instagrammable Hanoi Train Street, we decided to walk towards Lake of the Returned Sword. The evening was stuffy, the children were very hungry, and on a busy restaurant street, our daughter's attention was drawn to a stunning installation at the entrance – a huge ornamental tree expertly assembled from metal-framed bottles. It looked so stylish and beautiful that we instantly decided to have dinner here.The establishment was fully filled with guests, which immediately indicates its high popularity, but the staff worked professionally and promptly found available seats for our extended family of 5.🟟� RESULTS OF OUR GASTRONOMIC AUDIT:▪▪ Atmosphere and ergonomics: Because of the outdoor tropical spirit, we asked for an indoor table with air conditioning. We were seated at a gorgeous large table right across from the open kitchen. It is a stunning interior solution: watching the cooks work together is a separate aesthetic pleasure, and the beckoning aromas coming from the culinary area instantly whetted the appetite.▪⸏ Kitchen (Absolute delight): The menu at Puro House Restaurant offers a cool fusion of European and Asian premium dishes. We ordered two pizzas, roll sets, sushi and sashimi. The food was amazing! Perfect dough and juicy pizza toppings, freshest fish and impeccable proportions in a Japanese set. Texture, serving, balance of tastes ▪ all on the tower.▪▪ Drinks and service: For dinner, we took a bottle of quality sake, which was served in strict accordance with restaurant etiquette and at the perfect temperature. The price level here is comparable to good Moscow restaurants, but the quality of the products, the skill of the chef and the general atmosphere justify every dong in the check.▪️ Technical part and safety: Payment with an international bank card at the checkout was instant, the terminals work without disruption. And, as for family travelers with children, the most important marker of quality is important to us: the morning after a rich night's dinner there were absolutely no negative effects on the body and stomachs. The products here are guaranteed to be freshest and cleanest!🙌 SINCERE THANKS TO THE COLLECTIVE:We want to express our great gratitude to the entire Puro House Hanoi team – from the talented cooks in the open kitchen to the attentive waiters and hostesses. You have created a magnificent, civilized and very cozy place with soul, where European gloss perfectly blends with Asian hospitality.📝 SUMMARY:We sincerely and authoritatively recommend Puro House to all discerning tourists in Hanoi. If you want to get guaranteed delicious food, impeccable service and a safe gastronomic experience in the capital - you are definitely here!
